methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible, or from a clearly-cited reputable comparison/aggregator page where the official page returned a JS-only blank render or HTTP error. All prices are the recurring monthly cost: where billed annually, the annualized monthly rate is recorded in monthlyUsd and the month-to-month rate is noted in the plan notes; annualDiscountPct is set when both rates are published. Quote-only or 'contact sales' tiers carry monthlyUsd = null (never estimated). Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan as this is a non-telephony vertical. Impact.com plans include a 2.5% transaction fee on partner-driven sales in addition to the flat monthly fee, noted per plan. AWIN plans carry a per-transaction tracking fee in addition to the flat monthly fee, noted per plan. accessedAt on all sources is 2026-06-14.

vendors.name: Refersion
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page refersion.com/pricing rendered JS-only (blank body on automated fetch). Prices sourced from softwareadvice.com/marketing/refersion-profile/ which lists $119/mo and $299/mo as monthly rates and $99/mo and $249/mo as annual rates. Corroborated by sourceforge.net/software/product/Refersion/ showing identical figures.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $99/month billed annually; $119/month billed monthly. Includes 50 conversions tracked per month, unlimited affiliates, coupon and SKU tracking, performance reporting, referral link tracking, marketplace access, 30+ integrations.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $249/month billed annually; $299/month billed monthly. Includes 200 conversions tracked per month, all Professional features plus branded sending domain and program migration assistance.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Includes unlimited conversions, dedicated account manager, priority live support, advanced customization, tiered bonus rewards, gift card commission attribution, developer API access.

vendors.name: PartnerStack
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from partnerstack.com/pricing, which displays annual billing rates. Launch $1,000/mo and Growth $1,520/mo confirmed on two fetches. Enterprise is custom/quote-only.

plans.name: Launch
plans.notes: $1,000/month billed annually. Affiliate link tracking OR lead/deal registration, PartnerStack Marketplace access, AI tools, partner payments, onboarding and enablement tools, CRM integrations. Month-to-month rate not published.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: $1,520/month billed annually. All Launch features plus advanced integrations, Learning Management Solution, partner challenges and incentives, MDF management and payments, advanced partner segmentation. Month-to-month rate not published.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. All Growth features plus full link tracking + lead + deal registration, custom workflows and integrations, designated CSM, executive sponsorship, business reviews, priority support.

vendors.name: Impact
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from impact.com/plans-b2b/ which returned full plan details. Starter $30/mo, Essentials $500/mo, Pro $2,500/mo, Enterprise custom. All plans also carry a 2.5% transaction fee on partner-driven sales plus a one-time setup fee.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $30/month. Also charges a 2.5% transaction fee on partner-driven sales and a one-time setup fee (amount not published). Includes e-commerce platform integrations (Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Adobe Commerce, Squarespace), automated partner recommendations, promo code and link tracking, product feed automation, 40+ performance reports, chat support.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $500/month. Also charges a 2.5% transaction fee on partner-driven sales. All Starter features plus access to 90,000+ partners in marketplace, unlimited contract templates, unlimited event tracking, multi-domain programs, performance bonuses, automated campaign workflows.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $2,500/month. Also charges a 2.5% transaction fee on partner-driven sales. All Essentials features plus dedicated customer support, cross-device tracking, API-based tracking, Data Lab with customizable dashboards, SAML support, partner discovery via keyword search.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. All Pro features plus advanced analytics, fraud scoring, forecasting, anomaly detection, attribution risk protection, and specialized payout options.

vendors.name: Tapfiliate
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from tapfiliate.com/pricing. Launch $89/mo monthly or $74/mo annual; Scale $179/mo monthly or $149/mo annual; Enterprise custom. Annual discount stated as 17% (two months free).

plans.name: Launch
plans.notes: $74/month billed annually ($890/year); $89/month billed monthly. 1 affiliate program, 50 affiliates, 5,000 clicks/month (overage $1.50 per 1,000), 500 conversions/month (overage $15 per 1,000), 1 team member, 30+ integrations, real-time reporting, recurring commissions. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $149/month billed annually ($1,790/year); $179/month billed monthly. Unlimited programs and affiliates, 100,000 clicks/month (overage $1.00 per 1,000), 10,000 conversions/month (overage $10 per 1,000), 5 team members, advanced affiliate management, group/item-based commissions, MLM, automated payouts, deeplinks. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Unlimited everything, tailored clicks and conversions, unlimited team members, full white label, dedicated manager. 30-day free trial.

vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from postaffiliatepro.com/pricing. All four tiers confirmed: Starter $89/$79, Pro $139/$129, Ultimate $269/$249, Network $649/$599 (monthly/annual). Annual discounts calculated from published prices.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $79/month billed annually; $89/month billed monthly. 10,000 tracking requests/month; overage $5 per 10,000 requests. Unlimited affiliates, 24/7 lifetime support, AI Assistant, fraud protection, full setup/integration included.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $129/month billed annually; $139/month billed monthly. 1,000,000 tracking requests/month. All Starter features plus more than 220 integrations.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: $249/month billed annually; $269/month billed monthly. 6,000,000 tracking requests/month. Performance rewards, multiple administrators.

plans.name: Network
plans.notes: $599/month billed annually; $649/month billed monthly. 20,000,000 tracking requests/month; overage $0.20 per 10,000 requests. Multiple merchant accounts, membership subscription manager. For building affiliate networks.

vendors.name: Everflow
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page everflow.io/pricing confirmed quote-only: no published tiers. Page shows a 'Request Personalized Pricing' form asking about affiliate payout volume and business type. No self-serve pricing published.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Everflow does not publish self-serve pricing. All plans are quote-only via 'Request Personalized Pricing' form. Platform covers affiliate, influencer, and referral tracking.

vendors.name: Affise
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from affise.com/pricing. Affise Performance plans confirmed: Beginner $625/mo, Core $888/mo, Expand $1,239/mo, Custom $2,499/mo; all carry 7% annual discount. Third-party aggregators (softwareadvice.com, getapp.com) show lower legacy prices ($500/$800/$1,500) which appear to be outdated; official page prices used as authoritative source.

plans.name: Performance Beginner
plans.notes: $625/month billed monthly; ~$581/month billed annually (7% discount, ~$6,975/year). 7,000 conversions/month, 5M impressions, unlimited clicks, 50 offers, unlimited partners and users, Affise Pay, email support. 14-day trial.

plans.name: Performance Core
plans.notes: $888/month billed monthly; ~$826/month billed annually (7% discount, ~$9,912/year). 40,000 conversions/month, 15M impressions, 2 custom domains, unlimited offers/partners/users, Affise Pay, email and chat support, dedicated onboarding.

plans.name: Performance Expand
plans.notes: $1,239/month billed monthly; ~$1,152/month billed annually (7% discount, ~$13,835/year). 50,000 conversions/month, 20M impressions, 5 custom domains, unlimited offers/partners/users, dedicated customer success manager.

plans.name: Performance Custom
plans.notes: $2,499/month billed monthly; ~$2,324/month billed annually (7% discount, ~$27,888/year). Tailored conversions/impressions/custom domains, unlimited offers/partners/users, premium support, training sessions.

vendors.name: AWIN (ShareASale)
vendors.provenance: ShareASale redirects to awin.com/us (301). Pricing fetched from awin.com/us/pricing/advertisers. Access $49/mo + 3.5% tracking fee, Accelerate from $99/mo + 2.5% tracking fee, Advanced custom. Note: ShareASale was acquired by Awin in 2017; US advertiser pricing now unified under Awin brand.

plans.name: Access
plans.notes: $49/month flat fee plus 3.5% per-transaction tracking fee on all partner-driven sales. 3-month minimum contract with 14-day cancellation notice. First month free promotional offer. Access to Awin publisher network.

plans.name: Accelerate
plans.notes: From $99/month (floor price; exact amount varies) plus 2.5% per-transaction tracking fee. Flexible contract term (no minimum specified). Reduced transaction fee vs. Access plan.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Quote-only. Custom pricing for larger advertisers. No per-transaction fee rate published for this tier.

vendors.name: Trackdesk
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from trackdesk.com/pricing. Business $329/mo, Enterprise $499/mo, Enterprise PLUS from $1,199/mo confirmed. GetApp corroboration shows older/simplified pricing ($249/$499) which may reflect a legacy plan structure; official page figures used.

Unlimited seats, unlimited active offers, unlimited coupon tracking, 1,000+ integrations plus full API, full white-label and custom domain, fully managed migration, priority support with Zoom and Slack.
